<?php
/**
 * FileProcessorService - Kubernetes sidecar for processing uploaded artifacts
 * Deployed as part of the artifact-pipeline in k8s namespace 'processing'
 * 
 * This service watches a shared volume (emptyDir) for new files deposited by
 * the upload-gateway pod, validates them, and moves them to persistent storage.
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Service;

use Psr\Log\LoggerInterface;

class ArtifactProcessor
{
    private string $watchDir;
    private string $outputDir;
    private string $quarantineDir;
    private LoggerInterface $logger;
    private array $allowedExtensions = ['pdf', 'docx', 'xlsx', 'png', 'jpg'];
    private int $maxFileSize = 52428800; // 50MB

    public function __construct(LoggerInterface $logger)
    {
        $this->logger = $logger;
        $this->watchDir = getenv('WATCH_DIR') ?: '/shared/incoming';
        $this->outputDir = getenv('OUTPUT_DIR') ?: '/persistent/artifacts';
        $this->quarantineDir = getenv('QUARANTINE_DIR') ?: '/shared/quarantine';
        
        $this->ensureDirectories();
    }

    private function ensureDirectories(): void
    {
        foreach ([$this->watchDir, $this->outputDir, $this->quarantineDir] as $dir) {
            if (!is_dir($dir)) {
                mkdir($dir, 0750, true);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Main processing loop - called by the controller
     */
    public function processIncoming(): array
    {
        $results = ['processed' => 0, 'quarantined' => 0, 'errors' => 0];
        
        $entries = scandir($this->watchDir);
        if ($entries === false) {
            $this->logger->error('Failed to scan watch directory');
            return $results;
        }

        foreach ($entries as $entry) {
            if ($entry === '.' || $entry === '..') {
                continue;
            }
            
            $sourcePath = $this->watchDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $entry;
            
            try {
                if ($this->validateAndProcess($sourcePath, $entry)) {
                    $results['processed']++;
                } else {
                    $results['quarantined']++;
                }
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $this->logger->error('Processing error', [
                    'file' => $entry,
                    'error' => $e->getMessage()
                ]);
                $results['errors']++;
            }
        }

        return $results;
    }

    private function validateAndProcess(string $sourcePath, string $filename): bool
    {
        // Step 1: Validate filename format
        if (!$this->isValidFilename($filename)) {
            $this->quarantine($sourcePath, $filename, 'invalid_filename');
            return false;
        }

        // Step 2: Check file extension
        $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($filename, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
        if (!in_array($ext, $this->allowedExtensions, true)) {
            $this->quarantine($sourcePath, $filename, 'disallowed_extension');
            return false;
        }

        // Step 3: Reject symlinks entirely - do not process any symbolic links
        if (is_link($sourcePath)) {
            $this->quarantine($sourcePath, $filename, 'symlink_rejected');
            return false;
        }

        // Step 4: Validate file size
        $stat = stat($sourcePath);
        if ($stat === false) {
            $this->quarantine($sourcePath, $filename, 'stat_failed');
            return false;
        }

        if ($stat['size'] > $this->maxFileSize) {
            $this->quarantine($sourcePath, $filename, 'too_large');
            return false;
        }

        // Step 5: Resolve the canonical path to ensure it's within watch directory
        $canonicalSource = $this->resolveSecurePath($sourcePath);
        if ($canonicalSource === null) {
            $this->quarantine($sourcePath, $filename, 'path_traversal_attempt');
            return false;
        }

        // Step 6: Generate safe output filename with UUID prefix
        $safeFilename = $this->generateSafeFilename($filename);
        $destPath = $this->outputDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $safeFilename;

        // Step 7: Perform the secure copy operation
        return $this->secureCopy($canonicalSource, $destPath);
    }

    /**
     * Resolves path securely, ensuring it stays within allowed boundaries.
     * Uses realpath() on the FULL path to resolve all symlinks and canonicalize.
     */
    private function resolveSecurePath(string $path): ?string
    {
        // Resolve the FULL path including the file itself
        $resolvedPath = realpath($path);
        
        if ($resolvedPath === false) {
            return null;
        }

        $allowedBase = realpath($this->watchDir);
        if ($allowedBase === false) {
            return null;
        }

        // Verify the fully resolved path is within our watch directory
        if (strpos($resolvedPath, $allowedBase . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) !== 0 &&
            $resolvedPath !== $allowedBase) {
            return null;
        }

        return $resolvedPath;
    }

    /**
     * Performs a secure file copy with integrity verification
     */
    private function secureCopy(string $source, string $dest): bool
    {
        // Final symlink check right before opening (defense in depth against TOCTOU)
        if (is_link($source)) {
            $this->logger->error('Symlink detected at copy time', ['path' => $source]);
            return false;
        }

        // Open source for reading with O_NOFOLLOW semantics via stream context
        $sourceHandle = fopen($source, 'rb');
        if ($sourceHandle === false) {
            $this->logger->error('Failed to open source', ['path' => $source]);
            return false;
        }

        // Verify the opened file descriptor points to a regular file
        $fstat = fstat($sourceHandle);
        if ($fstat === false || ($fstat['mode'] & 0170000) !== 0100000) {
            fclose($sourceHandle);
            $this->logger->error('Source is not a regular file', ['path' => $source]);
            return false;
        }

        // Open destination with exclusive creation
        $destHandle = fopen($dest, 'xb');
        if ($destHandle === false) {
            fclose($sourceHandle);
            $this->logger->error('Failed to create destination', ['path' => $dest]);
            return false;
        }

        // Stream copy with hash verification
        $hashCtx = hash_init('sha256');
        $bytesWritten = 0;

        while (!feof($sourceHandle)) {
            $chunk = fread($sourceHandle, 8192);
            if ($chunk === false) {
                break;
            }
            hash_update($hashCtx, $chunk);
            $written = fwrite($destHandle, $chunk);
            if ($written === false) {
                break;
            }
            $bytesWritten += $written;
        }

        fclose($sourceHandle);
        fclose($destHandle);

        $hash = hash_final($hashCtx);
        
        // Set restrictive permissions on output
        chmod($dest, 0640);

        $this->logger->info('File processed', [
            'source' => basename($source),
            'dest' => basename($dest),
            'size' => $bytesWritten,
            'sha256' => $hash
        ]);

        // Remove the source file after successful copy
        unlink($source);

        return true;
    }

    private function isValidFilename(string $filename): bool
    {
        // Allow alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores, dots
        // Must not start with a dot (hidden files)
        if (preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{0,254}$/', $filename) !== 1) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // No double dots (path traversal)
        if (strpos($filename, '..') !== false) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private function generateSafeFilename(string $original): string
    {
        $ext = pathinfo($original, PATHINFO_EXTENSION);
        $uuid = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        return sprintf('%s_%s.%s', date('Ymd_His'), $uuid, $ext);
    }

    /**
     * Sanitize an arbitrary (possibly invalid/untrusted) filename so it is safe
     * to use as a leaf component of a destination path. Strips directory
     * components and any characters outside a conservative allowlist. Prevents
     * path traversal when quarantining files that failed filename validation.
     */
    private function sanitizeLeafName(string $filename): string
    {
        // Drop any directory components an attacker may have embedded.
        $leaf = basename($filename);
        // Replace anything outside the safe allowlist with underscore.
        $leaf = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/', '_', $leaf);
        // Neutralize any residual dot-dot sequences.
        $leaf = str_replace('..', '_', $leaf);
        // Avoid empty or dot-only names.
        if ($leaf === '' || $leaf === '.' || $leaf === '_') {
            $leaf = 'unnamed';
        }
        // Bound length.
        if (strlen($leaf) > 200) {
            $leaf = substr($leaf, 0, 200);
        }
        return $leaf;
    }

    private function quarantine(string $path, string $filename, string $reason): void
    {
        $this->logger->warning('File quarantined', [
            'file' => $filename,
            'reason' => $reason
        ]);

        // Sanitize the (possibly unvalidated) filename before using it to build
        // a destination path, preventing path traversal in the quarantine sink.
        $safeLeaf = $this->sanitizeLeafName($filename);

        $quarantinePath = $this->quarantineDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 
                         time() . '_' . $safeLeaf;
        
        if (file_exists($path) && !is_link($path)) {
            rename($path, $quarantinePath);
        } elseif (is_link($path)) {
            // Remove symlinks, don't move them
            unlink($path);
        }
    }
}

// Controller endpoint (simplified for k8s liveness/readiness + trigger)
class ProcessorController
{
    private ArtifactProcessor $processor;
    private LoggerInterface $logger;

    public function __construct(ArtifactProcessor $processor, LoggerInterface $logger)
    {
        $this->processor = $processor;
        $this->logger = $logger;
    }

    public function handleRequest(string $method, string $uri): string
    {
        if ($method === 'GET' && $uri === '/healthz') {
            return json_encode(['status' => 'healthy']);
        }

        if ($method === 'POST' && $uri === '/process') {
            $results = $this->processor->processIncoming();
            return json_encode(['status' => 'complete', 'results' => $results]);
        }

        http_response_code(404);
        return json_encode(['error' => 'not_found']);
    }
}
